parts.stem: Order the steps needed to measure weight using a spring scale.

items.value: Let the object go down slowly. The object pulls the spring downward and the reading of the pointer increases as the spring extends.
Hang the object whose weight you want to measure on the bottom hook.
Wait until the object stops moving and the spring settles. Look at the pointer and read the weight on the scale.
Hold the spring scale by the top hook.

correct_answer: Hold the spring scale by the top hook.
Hang the object whose weight you want to measure on the bottom hook.
Let the object go down slowly. The object pulls the spring downward and the reading of the pointer increases as the spring extends.
Wait until the object stops moving and the spring settles. Look at the pointer and read the weight on the scale.
